verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense is a SaaS product with AI features such as the Invoice Coding Agent and AI-powered spend management, so whether customers can opt out of AI training on their data is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual statement about training AI models on customer data, or about opting out of it. The AI feature mentions and the documentation MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit.
